purpose: Executable ledger for the `symmetry-anomaly-conservation` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Symmetry rows license only route-local symmetry wording. They cannot promote a route without anomaly, conservation, public-record, observed-sector, and candidate-native debts being separately paid.

symmetry_rows.symmetry_object: bulk/boundary symmetry action, center/topological operators, code-subspace automorphisms, and boundary Ward identities
symmetry_rows.realization_or_breaking_rule: Declare whether the symmetry is exact, approximate, emergent, gauged, explicitly broken, spontaneously broken, higher-form, non-invertible, duality-like, asymptotic, frame-relative, or only a simulator / metadata convention. In quantum-gravity routes, exact global-symmetry language is capped unless gauging, breaking, completeness, or no-global-symmetry residuals are explicit.
symmetry_rows.generalized_symmetry_or_duality_relation: Name the group, category, defect, charge lattice, Ward identity, current, topological operator, duality map, frame transform, or route-specific equivalence relation; identify whether it acts on states, operators, observables, records, sectors, or public artifacts.
symmetry_rows.symmetry_failure_mode: Failure can appear as hidden global symmetry in a quantum-gravity candidate, unmatched generalized symmetry, broken Ward identity, selected-sector-only invariance, duality mistaken for same ontology, simulator equivariance leakage, or metadata labels mistaken for physical symmetry.
symmetry_rows.symmetry_test: Stress the route by changing boundary/sector/gauge/regulator/frame/benchmark/survey choices and checking whether the declared symmetry action still maps admissible public or candidate-native objects to admissible public or candidate-native objects.
symmetry_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer candidate identity, quantum-gravity consistency, observed-sector recovery, or public-record closure from symmetry resemblance, duality vocabulary, approximate invariance, or clean equivariance unless anomaly and conservation rows also pass.

symmetry_rows.realization_or_breaking_rule: Metadata may use stable labels and identifiers, but it supplies no physical symmetry, charge action, generalized symmetry, duality, Ward identity, or no-global-symmetry test.
symmetry_rows.generalized_symmetry_or_duality_relation: No physical group, higher-form, non-invertible, duality, or frame symmetry is established by package metadata.
symmetry_rows.symmetry_failure_mode: Treating stable archive naming, row identifiers, or generated summaries as evidence of physical symmetry or route-native invariance.
symmetry_rows.symmetry_test: Verify that metadata rows remain custody-only and cannot satisfy route symmetry denominators.
symmetry_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer symmetry realization, anomaly freedom, conservation, or route promotion from metadata cleanliness.
